title: Instant Input ORAC 2.0

content:
This is my own fork of the brilliant TheTechnobear's ORAC 2.0!

It works exactly like ORAC 2.0 except by default parameter values on all modules update instantly to the current pot value rather than waiting for you to move each pot past the relevant parameter's previous value. So you get feedback right away!

You can also turn this behaviour off at any time in the Parallel Router module on the new last "Other" page I added- where you can set "Instant Params" to "off". This should put you back at vanilla 2.0 behaviour.

INSTALL: upload the .zop to the root of /sdcard/Patches via the web server, then reset storage and select install from the Patches menu on Organelle.

DISCLAIMERS: Not much testing here! Only works for Parallel router not Serial (currently). Only testing on Organelle M.

CREDITS:
All credit to Mark Harris (TheTechnobear). My changes here are small though they took an embarrassingly long time.
